info.title: KasiTek Public API
info.description: Growth public API for product sessions, workspace Developer API keys and resource-bound OAuth. Canonical REST, MCP and internal agents share operation schemas, authorization, requested private writes, exact public-action confirmation and bounded results. Deployment flags determine availability.

developerApiKey.description: Opaque workspace Developer API key. The raw key is shown once in Developers and is accepted as Authorization: Bearer kst_....

growthOAuth.description: Public-client authorization code with PKCE S256. Tokens target the configured Growth MCP resource. Refresh rotates tokens and replay revokes the connection.

scopes.growth:draft: Save requested private content drafts/media; review other record edits
scopes.growth:publish: Publish and schedule content; review non-content sends
